description_en: Lists the SSH public keys that are configured for a Bastionhost user. Users can use these public keys for key-based authentication when logging on to hosts through Bastionhost
description_zh: 查询用户名下所有的公钥列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-user-public-keys --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --user-id 2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListUserPublicKeys

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance where the user whose public keys you want to query resides.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询公钥的用户所在堡垒机的实例id。
>您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance where the user resides.

> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
用户的堡垒机的区域id。
>区域id和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the paged query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page for a paged query.
The maximum value of the PageSize parameter is 100. Default value: 20. If this parameter is empty, 20 entries are returned by default. > We recommend that you do not leave the PageSize parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
> 建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user whose public keys you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询公钥的用户ID
parameters.name: user_id
